properties.chose: (a), Anthony's word 2026-10-20 "Go with your recommendations": keep the α budget as built in #778 (a sum budget with Bonferroni shares, checked by budget_report; Holm and Benjamini–Hochberg recorded as the procedure's Decision, not judged). The default the recipe teaches stays family-wise error (FWER): reflow2's claims back decisions, where one false claim is what to avoid. Not (b) or (c) now: no trial has yet run a family large enough to need Holm's or BH's extra power, so new code waits for one; revisit when a trial does (Holm first, since it keeps the same FWER promise). properties.decision: OPEN, for Anthony. As built on feat/hypothesis-tests (2026-10-19), a family's α is a sum budget (composition sum): each test spends the α it ran at, and the served recipe gives Bonferroni shares rounded down. Holm (step-down) and Benjamini–Hochberg (false discovery rate) are not sums, so the recipe records the procedure as a Decision and keeps Bonferroni shares as the budget. Options: (a) keep it (as built; no code); (b) a new `composition` value (e.g. `holm`, `fdr_bh`) under which budget_report orders the family's p-values and judges each test's decision against its step-down threshold, reading the p-values from the recorded blocks; (c) leave the rollup alone and add a read-only family report beside it. Also open: whether FWER or FDR is the default the recipe teaches (as built: FWER, Bonferroni).
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-20: the α budget keeps Bonferroni shares, family-wise error is the default, and Holm/BH are recorded but not judged until a real trial needs them (option a)
properties.rationale: The requirement says add code only where the rollup cannot express it; Holm and BH are exactly what it cannot, so this is the owner's call rather than a guess. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
